audience: field-service teams that schedule jobs, crews and customers in FieldAware

useCases.title: Plan the jobs for a week
useCases.text: List the jobs in a time window with their state and assigned lead. Open one job to see its crew, tasks and items.

useCases.title: Find a customer's contacts and sites
useCases.text: List the customers, then read their contact persons and service locations.

useCases.title: Review invoices by created date
useCases.text: List invoices with their number, location and total amount. Limit the list to a created-date range.

useCases.title: Schedule a new job for a customer
useCases.text: Find the location and contact first. Then create the job with its date, time, location and job lead. Field staff will see the new job.

useCases.title: Change an existing job
useCases.text: Change the schedule, description, duration, location, contact, asset or lead of one job. Tasks, items and labor stay as they are.
